This exception is thrown to indicate that the operation (adding an event) is not allowed in the current state (not being in a step). The message of the exception includes the event name and the current history node, which helps in diagnosing the issue. The intent behind throwing this exception is to signal that the method was called in an inappropriate state, and the operation cannot proceed as expected.
